OptB: Lisinopril ACE inhibitor – contraindicated Hydralazine : - Safe vasodilator in prgnancy - Reduces afterload, improving cardiac output in heart failure Methyldopa : - Used for gestational hypertension - Not used for heart failure management In heart failure (including peripartum cardiomyopathy): - Avoid ACEI / ARB - Use hydralazine + nitrates
OptD: Methyldopa - Peripartum cardiomyopathy is a form of systolic heart failure occurring in the last month of pregnancy or within 5 months postpartum. - Management during pregnancy follows heart failure treatment that is safe in pregnancy. Drugs safe in pregnancy: - Diuretics (e.g., furosemide) for pulmonary congestion - Beta-blockers - Vasodilators like hydralazine - Nitrates Drugs contraindicated in pregnancy: ACE inhibitors and ARBs are teratogenic.
